create_TimeChecker: create a TimeChecker instance to start tracking elapsed time for visualization playback
get_time_TimeChecker: get the elapsed time since the TimeChecker began and optionally restart the clock
save_TimeChecker: save a timestamped message to the TimeChecker data list for later retrieval
get_data_TimeChecker: get the list of timestamped messages recorded by the TimeChecker
print_time_TimeChecker: print the elapsed time to the console and optionally restart the timer
